find:
<xf:foreach loop="$trophies" value="$trophy">
						<xf:datarow
							label="{$trophy.title}"
							hint="{{ phrase('points:') }} {$trophy.trophy_points}"
							href="{{ link('trophies/edit', $trophy) }}"
							delete="{{ link('trophies/delete', $trophy) }}" />
					</xf:foreach>
replace:
<xf:if is="$groupedTrophies is not empty">
					<xf:foreach loop="$groupedTrophies" value="$group">
						<xf:if is="$group.category">
							<xf:datarow rowtype="subsection"
								label="{$group.category.title}"
								href="{{ link('trophies/category-edit', null, {'category_id': $group.category.category_id}) }}"
								delete="{{ link('trophies/category-delete', null, {'category_id': $group.category.category_id}) }}" />
						<xf:else />
							<xf:datarow rowtype="subsection">
								<xf:cell colspan="2">{{ phrase('sylphian_trophy_uncategorised') }}</xf:cell>
							</xf:datarow>
						</xf:if>
						<xf:foreach loop="$group.items" value="$trophy">
							<xf:datarow
								label="{$trophy.title}"
								hint="{{ phrase('points:') }} {$trophy.trophy_points}"
								href="{{ link('trophies/edit', $trophy) }}"
								delete="{{ link('trophies/delete', $trophy) }}" />
						</xf:foreach>
					</xf:foreach>
<xf:else />
$0
</xf:if>
